verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own docs and repo say it loads into data warehouses, data lakes and databases through a large connector catalog, so multi-destination loading is a first-party capability. However, the evidence never names the specific destinations in the story, and nothing shows a pipeline being retargeted without changes. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres and object-storage destination connectors; documentation that a pipeline can switch destinations without modification; independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-destination loading.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I load to the major warehouses and lakes — Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, object storage — without changing pipelines

citations.quote: Airbyte provides a catalog of 600+ connectors for APIs, databases, data warehouses, data lakes
Consolidate data from hundreds of sources into your data warehouses, data lakes, and databases.
One-to-one table mapping: Data in one stream will always be mapped to one table in your data warehouse.
A sync mode governs how Airbyte reads from a source and writes to a destination.
